name: claude-mods
description: Function-hook mods for Claude Code, and the marketplace that offers them. Each folder is a standalone plugin; this package exists to pin the TypeScript the hooks are checked with and to hold the checks that span both.

scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict claude-cockpit-mod && claude plugin validate --strict claude-message-mod
scripts.test: claude plugin test claude-cockpit-mod && claude plugin test claude-message-mod
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:options && npm run check:marketplace && npm run validate && npm run test
